sentences.speaker: Judge Laura Burch
sentences.text: Mr. Clyde Shelton, you stand before this court charged with aggravated homicide and conspiracy.

sentences.speaker: Prosecutor Nick Rice
sentences.text: The Commonwealth requests bail be denied outright; the defendant represents an extraordinary flight risk and an active danger to society.

sentences.speaker: Clyde Shelton
sentences.text: Your Honor, the prosecution's entire petition relies upon circumstantial conjecture and precedent established in State v. Stewart, which requires tangible physical evidence before revoking pretrial liberty.

sentences.speaker: Judge Laura Burch
sentences.text: I find the defense argument persuasive on strict statutory grounds, and under normal procedure I would have been inclined to set bail at five hundred thousand dollars.

sentences.speaker: Clyde Shelton
sentences.text: Would you really let me walk out of here on bail when I just confessed to butchering a man with my bare hands?

sentences.speaker: Judge Laura Burch
sentences.text: I hold you in direct contempt of court; bail is formally revoked and you will be remanded to maximum security custody immediately.
